doc.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Getting Flip Phillips into Abe Lyman's band
summary: Bauer recommended Flip to Lyman; he explains how hotel residencies and radio worked for bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: I’m surprised that Flip — well we wrote a couple of, we had a little sextet or whatever. It was good times. We used to just meet and I know we had a room at the hotel, I forget where the hell it was, I think it was with Abe Lyman. I think I got in, oh I know I got him on Abe Lyman’s band, there was another guy, Russ Morgan? Was there a band by the name of Russ Morgan?
It doesn’t ring a bell with me.

But anyway, when Abe, on account of the Army, Abe didn’t want to take me out on the road for a ten week, you know the bands used to stay in a hotel, that was the business. Now I realize, I didn’t know it then, but they’d stay in a hotel like the Lincoln, which isn’t there anymore, and you’d do about ten weeks or three months in a hotel, and every night, or two nights a week you’d be on this radio you know. And then you’d go out and do one-nighters and colleges and things like that. So when you’d come back he says, “Lookit, Bill” he says, “for the eight weeks or so” he says, “I’m afraid to take you because I don’t want to be stuck in the middle of this eight weeks or something.” He says, “But when you come back will you open up in the St. Regis?” So he says, “I’ll give you a call.” So I says okay. So I went and did my business, whatever I was doing. He gave me a call and he says, “I need a saxophone player, a tenor.” I says, “Why don’t you get Flip?” But Flip, he couldn’t read very good at the time. Well I told Abe, I says, “He isn’t a good, good reader, but he’s got good ears.” But I don’t even know why I said that. I’d never seen Flip really read. We used to do things just by ear you know what I mean? So he come there, and Abe liked him so he was in the UN with me too with Abe.
